requirements.statement: A traveler signs in so their bookings are tied to their own account

criteria.must: A traveler can sign in via SSO before using the agent
A booking is associated with the signed-in traveler's own account

requirements.statement: A traveler describes destination, dates and preferences in natural language and the agent finds matching hotels

criteria.must: The agent accepts a natural-language description of destination, dates and preferences
The agent asks for missing details (e.g. dates) rather than assuming them
The agent returns hotels matching the stated destination and dates

requirements.statement: The agent shows comparable hotel/room options so the traveler can pick the best fit

criteria.must: Each presented option shows price, rating and amenities
Presented options are real results returned by the search, not invented

requirements.statement: A traveler books a specific room through the agent

criteria.must: The traveler can select a specific room and have the agent create a booking for it
The agent confirms the hotel, room, dates and price with the traveler before booking

requirements.statement: A booking is paid for at the time it is made, confirming the room rather than just holding it

criteria.must: A successful booking charges the traveler's payment at booking time
A booking whose payment is declined is not created as confirmed

requirements.statement: A traveler can view their existing bookings

criteria.must: A traveler can list their own upcoming bookings through the agent
A traveler cannot see another traveler's bookings

requirements.statement: A traveler can cancel an existing booking

criteria.must: A traveler can cancel one of their own bookings through the agent
Cancelling a booking refunds the payment taken for it
A traveler cannot cancel another traveler's booking
